name: Mamiya
source:
A mysterious girl who appeared in front of Haruki. She has a gentle smile and always wears a nurse uniform.

She considers herself to be Haruki's friend, and even seems to heal his wounds...

[Translated from [url=http://kenkou-land.com/mamiya/#chara]official website[/url]]
